# Product card spec, 2026-09-23

Designer S3c. Binding on `OxProductCard` and every grid, slider and wishlist
surface that renders it through the `product:card` registry key. Written against
the live preview measured on 2026-09-23 at 1440 and 390, `docs/build/DIRECTION.md`
sections 2, 3, 4.4, 5.3, 9, 10, `docs/build/X-IDENTITY-2026-09-22.md` sections 2
to 4, `docs/brand/voice-ksa.md` section 6 and
`docs/build/research/FINAL-claims-source.md` section 3.

Conventions as NAV-2026-09-23.md. New keys ship in
`locales/partials/s3c.{ar,en}.json` and are mirrored into `locales/{ar,en}.json`.

---

## 0. The claims law for this card, first

Everything below is subordinate to this section. A card is the densest claim
surface in the store, and this store has no reviews, no order history, no carrier
agreement and no VAT registration.

### 0.1 What the card may never say, in any state

Never a rating or a star when `rating.count` is 0. Never a review count. Never
الأكثر مبيعا, الأكثر طلبا, الأكثر شعبية, رقم 1, الأفضل, or any superlative.
Never a countdown, a timer, ينتهي خلال, باقي، or a sale end time. Never a
delivery promise (يصل خلال, شحن خلال يومين, توصيل سريع): the window is two
settings the owner fills once a carrier agreement exists
(`app/components/product/lib/claims.ts:141`). Never a viewer count, a purchase
count or a "N people are looking at this". Never a stock bar or a percentage
sold. Never مضمون or يضمن. Never a health, treatment or outcome claim. Never
موزع رسمي. Never a per serving price (owner decision, BUILD section 6). Never
منتج أصلي as a per card badge: that is the store wide line in the utility strip
and the PDP trust grid, and repeating it on 47 cards turns a store statement into
a product claim (`FINAL-claims-source.md` section 2 row 8).

### 0.2 What the card may say, and the exact gate

| Line | Gate, verbatim |
|---|---|
| saving percentage | `product.is_on_sale && Number(regular_price) > Number(sale_price)`; the figure is `product.discount_percentage` printed verbatim through the existing `savingPercent()` guard, never recomputed. When it is null, the amount from `savingOf()` renders instead |
| compare at price | `product.is_on_sale` only. `regular_price`, struck, preceded by an `ox-sr-only` `ox.pdp.was_price_label` (بدل) |
| كمية محدودة | `can_show_remained_quantity === true && is_hidden_quantity !== true && typeof quantity === 'number' && quantity > 0 && quantity <= 5`. The number is never printed |
| جديد | `isNewProduct(product)`, a real `created_at` inside 30 days |
| نباتي / منخفض السكر / خالي من الغلوتين | `bandBadges(product)[0]`, from a real Salla tag only, never inferred from a product name |
| الصلاحية {date} | `monthsUntilExpiry(spec.expiry)` is a number in `[0, 6)` |
| نفدت الكمية | `is_out_of_stock \|\| status === 'out'` |
| spec line | `parseSpecLine(product.description)`, the catalogue's own convention (`FINAL-claims-source.md` section 2 row 5) |
| rating | `rating.count > 0` only, already correct at `OxProductCard.tsx:214` |

### 0.3 One override, recorded

`FINAL-claims-source.md` section 5 reads "always show the regular price struck
through with the saving in riyals, never a percentage claim". That sentence
describes the mock catalogue's price discipline. The owner's instruction of
2026-09-23 permits a savings percentage when it is computed from a real compare
at price. **This spec follows the owner**, and narrows it: the percentage is
Salla's own `discount_percentage`, printed verbatim, gated on two real prices,
and it falls back to the riyal amount when the platform sends no figure. Nothing
is computed here that the dashboard could disagree with. Recorded as an override
rather than a reading, for the claims ledger.

## 2. Grid measurements

### 2.1 390, two up

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Viewport | 390, gutter `--ox-gutter` 16, container **358** |
| Grid | `grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: 16px; row-gap: 16px;` |
| Card outer | **171** |
| Card padding | 16, border 1px `--ox-bd`, radius `--ox-r-4` 16, fill `--ox-surface` |
| Card content | **137** |

Measured live: card 171.2, content 137.6. The spec uses 171 and 137.

### 2.2 1440, four up

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Viewport | 1440, gutter 32, container **1296** |
| Grid | `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); column-gap: 24px; row-gap: 32px;` |
| Card outer | **306** |
| Card content | **272** |

Row gap rises from 24 to 32 so the rows read as rows rather than as a mesh:
DIRECTION 4.1 sets the column gap at 24, 4.2 sets 32 as the desktop rhythm inside
a section. Measured live: 306 cards at a 24 column gap, confirmed.

### 2.3 The other two

| Width | Grid | Card | Content |
|---|---|---|---|
| 640 to 1023 | 3 up, gutter 24, gap 24 | 181 | 147 |
| 1024 to 1279, with the 280 filter rail | 3 up, gap 24 | 288 | 254 |

### 2.4 The arrangement switch is a container query, not a media query

`.ox-card-product` already declares `container-type: inline-size; container-name:
oxcard`. The switch is `@container oxcard (min-width: 240px)`.

| Surface | container | arrangement |
|---|---|---|
| 390 two up | 137 | mobile |
| 640 to 1023 three up | 147 | mobile |
| 1024 three up beside the rail | 254 | desktop |
| 1440 four up | 272 | desktop |
| PDP related rail at 1440 | about 179 | mobile |

The same 1440 screen holds a 306 grid card and a 211 rail card; only the narrow
one needs the compact arrangement. The file's own note at `_b3-product.scss:20`
makes exactly this argument.

## 3. Anatomy and row heights

Reading order, start to end, top to bottom. Gaps: 12 between the plate and the
body, 8 between body rows, 12 before the action block.

| # | Slot | 390 h | 1440 h | Present |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | image plate | **137** | **272** | always |
| 2 | brand line | 18 | 18 | only when `product.brand?.name` is non empty |
| 3 | title | **44** | **46** | always |
| 4 | spec line | 18 | 18 | always, reserved even when empty |
| 5 | price row | 30 | 32 | always |
| 6 | stock line | 18 | 18 | only on the `quantity <= 5` gate |
| 7 | variant chips | 32 | 32 | always, reserved even when empty |
| 8 | quantity row | 40 | absent | mobile arrangement only |
| 9 | action row | 44 | 44 | always |
| 10 | buy row | absent | 44 | desktop arrangement only |

Card height, base (no brand, no stock line):

- **390**: `17 + 137 + 12 + 44 + 8 + 18 + 8 + 30 + 8 + 32 + 12 + 40 + 8 + 44 + 17 = 435`
- **1440**: `17 + 272 + 12 + 46 + 8 + 18 + 8 + 32 + 8 + 32 + 12 + 44 + 8 + 44 + 17 = 578`

Each conditional row adds 26 (row plus its gap). Measured live today: 434 and 486.

**Equal height (DIRECTION 4.4).** The grid is `align-items: stretch`; the card is
a flex column; the action block carries `margin-block-start: auto`. A row where
one card is taller than its neighbour is a G2 failure.

### 3.1 The plate

`aspect-ratio: 1 / 1`, `inline-size: 100%`, `max-block-size: none`. **Delete
`--ox-card-plate-max`** and its listing override.

Measured defect: at 390 the plate is 137.6 x 132 holding a 137.6 square image
under `overflow: hidden`, a 2.8px cut each side; at 1440 it is 272.4 x 184 holding
a 272.4 square image, a **44px cut each side, 24% of every product photograph in
the grid**. DIRECTION 5.3 specifies a 1:1 plate.

Plate fill stays **transparent**, not `--ox-plate`. This is a recorded departure
from DIRECTION 5.3 and the reason is the file's own
(`_b4-listing.scss` section 12 preamble): every photograph in this catalogue is a
lossy file with a baked in white ground, so a grey plate draws a visible white
rectangle inside a grey box on every card.

Image: `object-fit: contain`, engine `Image` with `aspectRatio="1/1"` so the box
is reserved before decode, and explicit `width`/`height` attributes on the `img`.

Overlays on the plate:

| Overlay | Position | Size |
|---|---|---|
| badge stack | top inline-**end** corner, column, gap 4 | max **two** badges, 20 tall each |
| wishlist | top inline-**start** corner, offset -4 | 44 x 44 hit, glyph 20 |
| colour preview dots | plate's inline-end edge, vertically centred, column, gap 4 | 14 x 14, max 4 |

### 3.2 The brand line

18 tall, 12/600, `--ox-fg-3` (6.35:1 on `--ox-card`), one line with ellipsis,
wrapped in `<bdi>` (DIRECTION 3.4: a Latin island inside Arabic copy is isolated).

**It is not reserved when absent.** The catalogue has zero brands today, so a
reserved row costs 26px of hole on every card in the store. That is the exact
defect `OxProductCard.tsx:205-213` already removed for the rating row, with the
same argument, and the same argument applies here: nothing is gained by reserving
a row that is empty on every card at once. When brands land they land per
supplier, so the row fills uniformly and equal height is preserved.

### 3.3 The title

`<h3>` containing the stretched `<Link>`. Exactly two lines,
`-webkit-line-clamp: 2`, `min-block-size` equal to two line boxes. 390: 15/700 at
`--ox-lh-snug` 1.45, 43.5 rounded to 44. 1440: 16/700, 46.4 rounded to 46.
Colour `--ox-fg`. Product name inside `<bdi>` (already correct).

### 3.4 The spec line

**The merchant `subtitle` pitch line is removed.** Measured live at 390 it renders
as a single ellipsised line cut mid word: "واى ايزوليت نقى بـ 25 ج...". A
marketing sentence truncated at 18 characters conveys nothing and it is not a
spec. `OxProductCard.tsx:81-103` argued for it on the grounds that every other
option was closed; the spec line was not closed, it was only unparsed at the card.

In its place, 18 tall, 13/600, `--ox-ink-4` (#6D7173, **4.93:1** on `--ox-card`,
so it clears AA and may carry information), always reserved:

```
cardSpecLine(product, spec):
  servings = spec.servings !== null ? t('ox.card.servings', { n: spec.servings }) : null
  pack     = specField(spec, PACK_SIZE_LABELS) ?? unitBearingWeight(product.weight)
  parts    = [servings, pack].filter(Boolean)
  if parts.length  -> parts.join(DIVIDER)
  else if spec?.form -> spec.form
  else -> null   (the row keeps its 18px)
```

`DIVIDER` is the existing constant in `OxProductCard.tsx:54` (hair space, pipe,
hair space), so the theme keeps one separator. The pack size prints **verbatim**
and only when it carries its own unit: `unitBearingWeight()` already drops a bare
number, because a number with no unit sitting beside a price reads as a price.
Wrap the pack size in `<bdi>`; Western digits everywhere (DIRECTION 3.3).

Typical rendered value: `30 حصة | 907 جم`, measured 92.8 at 13/600, inside 137.

### 3.5 The price row

30 tall at 390, 32 at 1440, `align-items: baseline`, gap 8.

| Part | Treatment |
|---|---|
| amount | `Price size="card"`, 20/800 at 390, 22/800 at 1440, `--ox-fg` |
| riyal mark | Salla's `sicon-sar` glyph wrapped by `Price.tsx` in a `role="img"` span with `aria-label` and a selectable `ox-sr-only` twin. **Unchanged. Do not touch this file.** |
| compare at | `<s>` 13/600 `--ox-fg-3`, preceded by an `ox-sr-only` بدل |
| saving line | **none.** The badge states it once (owner call 2026-09-22, already in the code). A figure printed twice stretches every card |

Red never appears on a price (DIRECTION 2.5). The saving is `--ox-go`.

### 3.6 The stock line

18 tall, 13/600, `--ox-note` (#8A5E0E, **5.69:1** on `--ox-card`), text only, no
icon, no bar. Value `ox.card.limited_qty` (كمية محدودة). Gate in section 0.2.
Not reserved when absent.

### 3.7 The variant chips row

32 tall, always reserved. `VariantChips` returns an empty box for
`option === null`, which is what keeps every card in a grid on the same row count.
**Unchanged.**

One new rule: **when `cardOption(product)` returns a colour option, the plate's
colour preview dots do not render.** One axis gets one control and one preview,
never both.

### 3.8 The colour preview dots

14 x 14, `border-radius: --ox-r-pill`, 1px `--ox-bd-2`, fill from the product's
own option hex, `pointer-events: none` so a tap passes through to the stretched
title link. Selected dot: `outline: 2px solid var(--ox-fg)`, `outline-offset: 2px`.
Max 4. A listing payload that carries only value names shows none, by design
(`colourSwatches()` requires a real hex). **Unchanged.**

## 4. The action block

### 4.1 Mobile arrangement, container under 240 (390 card, content 137)

Two rows, the owner's rule verbatim.

**Row A, quantity, its own row, 40 tall, full 137.**

```
| -  44 | value (flex) | +  44 |
```

1px `--ox-bd-2`, radius `--ox-r-2` 8, straight edges. `-` and `+` are 44 x 40
with the icons at 16; the value is an `<output>` (a live region by default) at
15/700 centred. `aria-label` on each button from `ox.pdp.quantity_decrease` and
`ox.pdp.quantity_increase`; the group carries `role="group" aria-label={ox.pdp.quantity}`.
Disabled at 1 and at `max_quantity`: `--ox-ink-4`, `cursor: not-allowed`.

**Row B, the two controls, 44 tall.**

`display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 3fr; gap: 8px;` which is 40 and 60 per
cent of the 129 available: add **52**, buy **77**.

| Control | Treatment |
|---|---|
| add, icon only | `Icon name="cart" size={20}`, outline face (1px `--ox-fg`, fill `--ox-card`), radius `--ox-r-2`, 52 x 44. `aria-label` set unconditionally to the same word the desktop prints, so the accessible name never depends on which CSS rule is in effect (already done at `OxProductCard.tsx:516`) |
| buy | `ox.card.buy_now` (اشتر الآن), accent fill, label `--ox-on-accent`, **15/700**, no icon at this width, `padding-inline: 8`, radius `--ox-r-2`, 77 x 44 |

Label measured 58.0 at 15/700; 58 plus 16 of padding equals 74, inside 77.

### 4.2 Desktop arrangement, container 240 and over (1440 card, content 272)

**Row A, 44 tall**: `display: flex; gap: 8px;`

```
| add  156 | 8 | stepper 108 |
```

Stepper `flex: 0 0 108px`, three 36 wide cells at 44 tall (36 clears WCAG 2.5.8's
24px floor on the inline axis and the block axis is 44). Add `flex: 1 1 auto`,
**156**, text label `ox.card.add` (أضف للسلة) at 14/600 with the cart glyph 16 at
the start, outline face, radius `--ox-r-2`. Label measured about 67; 67 plus glyph
16 plus gap 8 plus 32 of padding equals 123, inside 156.

**Row B, 44 tall**: buy, full 272, `ox.card.buy_now` with the `bolt` icon 16,
16/700, accent fill. Label 61.9 plus icon 16 plus gap 8 plus 40 of padding equals
126, inside 272.

### 4.3 The cart path stays Salla's

`SallaAddProductButtonCore` owns the options modal, the cart request, the toast
and the notify form. The card sizes and colours it and hands it a `quantity`.
Nothing calls `salla.cart`. The `can_quick_buy` gate on the buy control is
unchanged: where the platform has quick buy on, the control is Salla's own quick
buy; where it is off (all 47 products today) it is a link to the product page,
and it is not dressed up as a one tap buy beyond the label. **Unchanged.**

## 5. The sold out state

`.ox-card-product.is-out`:

| Part | Treatment |
|---|---|
| plate | `opacity: 0.72`. **No `filter: grayscale()`**, which would spend the compositor budget on every out of stock card |
| badges | `نفدت الكمية`, `tone="stop"`, and nothing else. The saving badge is suppressed |
| price | stays (DIRECTION 5.3) |
| quantity row | removed |
| variant chips | removed |
| action | one full width control, 44 tall |
| wishlist | stays live |

The control is `ox.card.notify_me` (نبهني عند التوفر) through
`SallaAddProductButtonCore` with `productStatus` passed, outline face, when the
product carries `notify_availability` or the status is out and notify. Otherwise
`ox.card.unavailable` (غير متوفر): `--ox-ink-4` on `--ox-fill`, 1px `--ox-bd`,
`aria-disabled="true"`, **focusable**, not a `<button disabled>`. A disabled
control leaves the tab order and explains nothing.

**Equal height in a mixed row.** Removing three rows makes the card 92 shorter,
which DIRECTION 4.4 forbids. `.ox-card-product.is-out .ox-card-product__body`
takes a `min-block-size` equal to the live card's body height and the notify
control keeps `margin-block-start: auto`, which is the mechanism 4.4 already
specifies.

## 6. Colour, type and the one angled primitive

### 6.1 The card's one angled primitive is the saving badge's notch

`@include ox-x-notch(4px, 14px)` at the badge's inline-end, `border-radius: 0`.
A notch on a rounded box reads as damage, so the saving badge alone among the
badges is square. Badge block-size 20, so `t 4` fits; `j 14.0` is inside the
badge's 60px minimum width.

**Both existing angles come off the card**:

| Call site | Change |
|---|---|
| `_b4-listing.scss:1447` `.ox-card-product__add .s-button-element` `ox-angled(40px)` | removed, `border-radius: var(--ox-r-2)` |
| `_b4-listing.scss:1636` `.ox-card-product__buy` `ox-angled(44px)` plus `margin-inline: 8px` | both removed, `border-radius: var(--ox-r-2)` |
| `_b4-listing.scss:1709` `.ox-card-product__buy--native .s-button-element` `ox-angled(44px)` plus the `calc(100% - 16px)` at `:1678` | both removed, `border-radius: var(--ox-r-2)` |

Three independent reasons, any one sufficient:

1. **X-IDENTITY section 3.3**: "One angled gesture per component block. A card
   that takes the corner cut does not also take a notch, a skewed price or an
   angled badge. This is enforced, not advised." The card carries two today.
2. **X-IDENTITY section 2.4**: "Any control narrower than `run / 0.24` loses the
   parallelogram and becomes `.ox-cta-pill`. That is a hard rule, not a
   preference." `ox-run(44px)` is 29.7, so the floor is **123.75**. The 390 buy
   button is **77**. The parallelogram is illegal there on the identity
   document's own terms.
3. **Measured**: `.ox-card-product__buy` renders 137.6 wide at x 729.6 inside a
   content box running 737.6 to 875.2, overhanging the card by 8px on the inline
   end at 390, and identically at 1440. `margin-inline: 8px` was added at `:1633`
   without the matching `inline-size: calc(100% - 16px)` that the `--native`
   variant carries at `:1678`. With the angle gone the margin goes too and the
   button is flush.

X-IDENTITY section 3.3 names "Price tag / saving badge, notch `t 4 / j 14.0` at
the inline-end, no lean" as a card scale device, so the badge is the sanctioned
carrier. A bonus that matters: nothing focusable on the card is clipped any more,
so section 3.4's `focus-clipped` hazard disappears from this component.

### 6.2 The badge stack

Maximum **two**, in this priority. Box 20 tall, 12/700, `padding-inline: 8`,
radius `--ox-r-1` 6 except where stated.

| # | Badge | Fill | Label | Measured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ox.card.out_of_stock` نفدت الكمية | `--ox-stop-soft` #FBEAE8 | `--ox-stop` #B3261E | 5.61:1 |
| 2 | `ox.pdp.save_label` + percent or amount | `--ox-go` #0F7B4F, **radius 0 plus the notch** | `--ox-paper` #FFFFFF | 5.29:1 |
| 3 | `ox.common.new` جديد | `--ox-card` with 1px `--ox-bd-2` | `--ox-fg` | 16:1 |
| 4 | `bandBadges(product)[0]`, tone `tag` | `--ox-card` with 1px `--ox-bd-2`, glyph 12 | `--ox-fg` | 16:1 |
| 5 | `ox.card.expiry` الصلاحية {date} | `--ox-note-soft` #FBF2E0 | `--ox-note` #8A5E0E | 5.12:1 |

Badge 1 suppresses every other. Never orange, never a shadow, never a gradient.

### 6.3 The accent label colour, and the token it exposes

White on `--ox-accent` #F54915 measures **3.59:1**. That fails AA for normal text
and is legal only under the large text exemption, which is why `_b4-listing.scss:1613`
pins the card CTA at 19px. A 19px label does not fit a 77px mobile button.

DIRECTION section 2.2 already declares `--ox-on-accent` as ink, and the document's
own opening measurement says "This document uses ink on orange for primary buttons
(4.87:1), the same pairing the logo itself uses". The live ink `--ox-ink` is
`#12171E`; on `#F54915` it measures **5.01:1**, which passes AA at any size.

**Set `--ox-on-accent: var(--ox-ink)` in `app/styles/tokens.css`.** It restores
DIRECTION 2.2 rather than inventing anything, it frees the card CTA to 15 and 16,
and it fixes every primary button in the theme at once. The site wide consequence
is named here deliberately: the hero button, the PDP buy row and the newsletter
button all change from white to ink on orange. If the conductor wants white kept
elsewhere, the card scopes the override instead and the divergence is recorded
against DIRECTION 2.2 for the owner.

`--ox-accent` #F54915 on `--ox-card` is 3.59:1 and **never carries text** on this
card; the accent appears only as a fill and as the active wishlist glyph, both of
which are graphical objects under WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 floor.

### 6.4 The type ladder on the card

| Slot | 390 | 1440 |
|---|---|---|
| price amount | 20 / 800 | 22 / 800 |
| title | 15 / 700 | 16 / 700 |
| add label | icon only | 14 / 600 |
| buy label | 15 / 700 | 16 / 700 |
| spec, compare at | 13 / 600 | 13 / 600 |
| brand | 12 / 600 | 12 / 600 |
| badge | 12 / 700 | 12 / 700 |

The price to title ratio is 1.33 and the price to spec ratio is 1.54. Arabic
letter spacing is 0 at every size; character comes from weight (DIRECTION 3.2).
Western digits everywhere (DIRECTION 3.3).

## 7. States

| Target | Rest | Hover | Focus | Active |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| card | 1px `--ox-bd` | border `--ox-bd-2` at `--dur-fast`, **and the second product image cross fades in**. **No lift, no scale, no shadow** | n/a (the title link owns it) | n/a |
| title link | `--ox-fg` | inherits the card | `--ox-focus-ring` offset 2 painted on the stretched `::after` | n/a |
| wishlist | outline heart `--ox-fg` | `--ox-accent-soft` circle | `--ox-focus-ring` offset -4 | `aria-pressed`, filled heart `--ox-accent` |
| stepper button | 1px `--ox-bd-2` | fill `--ox-fill` | `--ox-focus-ring` offset -2 | fill `--ox-plate` |
| add | outline `--ox-fg` on `--ox-card` | fill `--ox-fill` | `--ox-focus-ring` offset 2 | fill `--ox-plate` |
| buy | `--ox-accent` fill, `--ox-on-accent` label | `--ox-accent-dark` | `--ox-focus-ring` offset 2 | `--ox-accent-dark`, no transform |

**Delete `.ox-card-product:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) }`**
(`_b3-product.scss:39`). BUILD 3.4 and DIRECTION 5's three defaults both forbid
the lift; "a hover transition on every card" is a named template tell. The hover
that stays is the border colour and the second image, and the second image is
information rather than decoration, which is what makes it a decision.

The second image is `@media (hover: hover)` only, `opacity` only, `--dur-fast`.

---

## 8. Motion

| Moment | Property | Duration and easing |
|---|---|---|
| second image | `opacity` | `--dur-fast` 120ms `--ease-out` |
| hover border | `border-color` | `--dur-fast` |
| add confirm | Salla's own loader, then the label swaps to `ox.card.added` | `--dur-confirm` 160ms |
| cart count bump | owned by `MainBar` | 160ms |

Nothing else moves. **The grid never staggers and never reveals**: X-IDENTITY
section 5.1 leaves `--stagger-step` exactly one consumer, the goals grid, and
lists "Product rails, product grids, listings" as never revealing. A
fade-and-slide-up on every card is the named tell this rule exists to prevent.

Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: the second image swap is instant, the
border change is instant, the confirm label still swaps because it is information.

## 9. Accessibility

| Requirement | How |
|---|---|
| one tab stop per card for navigation | the title link is stretched over the card with a `::after`; the wishlist, stepper, add and buy raise themselves above it with `z-index` |
| accessible names | wishlist `ox.a11y.wishlist_toggle` plus `aria-pressed`; stepper buttons `ox.pdp.quantity_decrease` and `ox.pdp.quantity_increase`; add `aria-label` equal to its visible desktop label, set unconditionally so Label in Name holds in both arrangements; the colour list `aria-label={ox.card.colours}` with an `ox-sr-only` name per dot |
| quantity announcement | `<output>` is a live region by default |
| compare at price | an `ox-sr-only` بدل before the struck figure, so a screen reader does not read two prices as a range |
| currency | the `sicon-sar` glyph is wrapped by `Price.tsx` in `role="img"` with an `aria-label` and a selectable `ox-sr-only` twin. Do not change it |
| bidi | product name, brand and pack size in `<bdi>`; punctuation outside the island (DIRECTION 3.4) |
| tap targets | wishlist 44 x 44; stepper 44 x 40 mobile and 36 x 44 desktop; add 52 x 44 mobile and 156 x 44 desktop; buy 77 x 44 and 272 x 44; dots are not targets. Every target clears WCAG 2.5.8's 24px floor on both axes and 44 on at least one |
| focus visibility | `--ox-focus-ring` on every control; no control sits on a `clip-path` selector after section 6.1 |
| contrast, measured | `--ox-fg` 16:1, `--ox-fg-3` 6.35:1, `--ox-ink-4` 4.93:1, `--ox-go` 5.29:1, `--ox-note` 5.69:1, `--ox-stop` 6.54:1, ink on accent 5.01:1. Nothing on the card is below 4.5:1 except `--ox-accent` used as a fill, which is graphical |
| image dimensions | explicit `width` and `height` on every `img`, plus `aspectRatio="1/1"` so the box is reserved before decode |

---

## 10. Skeleton and CLS

`.ox-card-product--skeleton` mounts at the **base** height, 435 at 390 and 578 at
1440, with the same row boxes drawn in `--ox-plate-2`.

Per DIRECTION 10.1 A7: block rectangles are **static**; the 1.2s opacity pulse
(1 to 0.6 to 1, `--ease-in-out`) runs only on the text line bars inside the one
skeleton root currently in the viewport, moved by an `IntersectionObserver`. Under
reduced motion nothing pulses and the bars sit at 0.8.

CLS is 0 on a server rendered grid: the two conditional rows arrive with the data
in the same paint. The skeleton is seen only on client pagination through
`LoadMore`, where its height must equal the base exactly.

---

## 11. Render budget

| Rule | State after this spec |
|---|---|
| Glows are radial gradients, never `filter: blur()` | no `filter` on the card in any state, including sold out |
| `backdrop-filter` | **zero** on the card. A per item backdrop root is forbidden outright and 24 cards would be 24 roots |
| No permanent promotion | no `will-change`, no `translateZ(0)`; the second image animates `opacity` only, for 120ms |
| No `filter` on an ancestor of `background-clip: text` | not used |
| Scrollers | the grid is not a scroller. The home rail's root (`ProductsSliderWrapper`) must carry `position: relative` |
| Visually hidden text | `.ox-sr-only` clip rect only |
| **Decoded image memory** | see below |

**The image request rule.** DIRECTION 10.4 A8: the build requests the CDN width
nearest **2x** the slot, never 3x, and the listing's first viewport line is
**1.4 MB**.

Ship `srcSetWidths={[160, 220, 300]}` and
`sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 272px, (min-width: 640px) 30vw, 138px"`.

Capping the candidate list at 300 is the mechanism, not the `sizes` string: a 390
phone at DPR 3 asks for about 414 whatever `sizes` says, and takes the largest
candidate at or below its request plus the browser's own tolerance. With 300 as
the ceiling, one plate decodes at 300 x 300 x 4 bytes equal 360 KB, and the four
plates on the first viewport come to **1.44 MB**, which is DIRECTION 10.4's
listing line. The current `[150, 300, 500]` lets a phone take the 500 file, 1 MB
per plate, 4 MB on the first viewport.

**The hover image is gated.** Today it is always in the DOM at `opacity: 0`, so a
phone fetches and decodes a **second** image per card: about 2.88 MB on the first
viewport against a 1.4 MB line. Mount it only when
`useHoverCapable()` returns true, evaluated after hydration so the server tree
emits one image and the client tree matches on the first pass.

`priority={imagePriority || index < 2}` stays; every other plate is
`loading="lazy"`.

---

## 12. Anti template reading

Dimensions the card shows, against the G2 floor of four:

1. **Scale contrast hierarchy**: 20/800 price against 15/700 title against 13/600 spec, a 1.54 ratio across three steps.
2. **Intentional spacing rhythm**: 12 / 8 / 12 inside the card, 16 in the mobile grid, 24 by 32 in the desktop grid.
3. **Semantic colour**: `--ox-go` for a saving, `--ox-note` for expiry and low stock, `--ox-stop` for sold out, the accent reserved to one control.
4. **Designed hover, focus and active states**: the second product image, the border, the ring painted on the stretched pseudo, the pressed plate.
5. **Typographic character**: 800 on the price, Western digits, Salla's own riyal glyph with a written twin.
6. **Depth and layering**: the plate, the badge stack above it, the swatch column on its edge, the stretched link beneath the raised controls.

Named tells, checked: no single word headline accent, no all caps micro label, no
eyebrow above a heading, no `01/02/03` marker, no fade and slide up. The one tell
present today, a hover transition on every card, loses its lift and keeps a named
border change whose real payload is the second product image.

## 14. Verification list

Run at 390 x 844 and 1440 x 900 on `/ar/protein/c9001`, `/ar/offers` and `/ar`,
and on `/en` for the twin.

1. `pnpm check:copy`, `node scripts/check-claims.mjs` and `pnpm vitest run tests/i18n.test.ts tests/i18n-keys.test.ts tests/i18n-claims.test.ts` are green.
2. Every card in a row reports the same `getBoundingClientRect().height`, on a row that mixes an on sale product, a full price product, a product with options and a sold out product.
3. Card outer is 171 at 390 and 306 at 1440; content is 137 and 272; base height 435 and 578, plus or minus 1.
4. The plate's `getBoundingClientRect()` is square at both widths, and the plate's height equals its width.
5. The product image's rendered `currentSrc` at 390 is the 300 candidate, never 500. Four plates on the first viewport decode under 1.5 MB total (DevTools Memory, or `performance.getEntriesByType('resource')` transfer sizes as a proxy).
6. On a touch only emulation the hover image is **absent from the DOM**, not merely transparent.
7. `.ox-card-product__buy` sits flush inside the card's content box at both widths: its `x` equals the body's `x` and its width equals the body's width on desktop, and its grid cell on mobile.
8. No element inside `.ox-card-product` has a computed `clip-path` other than the saving badge.
9. `getComputedStyle(card).transform` is `none` on hover.
10. A card with `rating.count === 0` renders no rating row and no empty 20px box.
11. A product with no brand renders no brand row; a product with a brand renders one, and a row containing both still has equal heights.
12. The spec line renders `30 حصة | 907 جم` shape on a product whose description carries both fields, the pack size alone where servings are missing, and stays 18 tall where both are missing.
13. A product with `quantity` 3 and `can_show_remained_quantity` true shows كمية محدودة; one with `quantity` 3 and the flag false shows nothing; the number is never printed.
14. The saving badge prints Salla's own `discount_percentage` string and disappears entirely when `is_on_sale` is false, even if `regular_price` is set.
15. At most two badges render on any card in the catalogue.
16. A sold out card shows نفدت الكمية, keeps its price, drops the stepper and the chips, shows one full width control, and is the same height as its neighbours.
17. Keyboard: Tab reaches the card once for the title, then the wishlist, the stepper minus, the value skip, the stepper plus, the add and the buy, in that order, each with a visible ring.
18. The DevTools accessibility audit scores 100 on `/ar/protein/c9001` at 390 and 1440, with zero contrast and zero name findings on any card.
19. Compositor probe (`mastermind-audit/references/mobile-render-budget.md` section 4) at 390 x 844 x 3 on the listing: zero `backdrop-filter` roots, zero `filter` elements, zero forced layers, zero fixed elements past the viewport, `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` equal to 390.
20. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no image cross fade, no border transition, no skeleton pulse; the add confirm label still swaps.
21. `--ox-on-accent` resolves to `#12171E` and the buy label measures 5.01:1 against `--ox-accent`.

## 15. Addendum, 2026-09-24 — the card made compact (S9a-V4)

Owner review of the "منتجات قد تناسبك" rail at 1905px. Verbatim: "products
vertical size to be minimal while allowing a breathing space, but I don't
like how the variants space is making the card larger, consider maybe
setting the variants on the product image on the product card, and remove
the free consultation on the card, it is not necessary and taking
unnecessary space"; then "the background grey and orange shapes behind the
product image in the product page to be used as the background on featured
products cards behind the image"; and, from the header audit the same day,
"if anything can't be integrated in Shopify, delete it" — the wishlist
heart.

This is a binding override of the sections below, recorded here rather than
edited into them, so the reasoning that led to the original spec stays
readable:

- **Section 3.1's wishlist corner** and **section 4**'s wishlist references:
  `.ox-card-product__wish` is gone outright. The PDP gallery's own wishlist
  control is a separate, untouched decision (still section 7 of the
  gallery's own rules, not this card's).
- **Section 3, row 11 (consult link)**, added by S8g item 1 after this spec
  shipped: gone outright. `ox.card.free_consult` stays in the locale files,
  unused, on the brief's own instruction, in case a future surface wants it.
- **Section 3.7 and section 4's variant chips row**: no longer a row below
  the image at all. The chooser (`VariantChips`) now renders inside the
  plate itself, bottom-start, a compact translucent strip only when it
  actually holds a real choice (an `:empty` reservation paints nothing), so
  it costs the card's vertical budget zero height. The passive colour
  preview dots (section 3.8, the plate's trailing edge) are unchanged and
  keep suppressing themselves against the same axis the chooser already
  covers (section 3.7's "one axis, one control and one preview" rule still
  holds, now with both living on the plate rather than one above the other).
- **Section 3.1's plate fill**, "stays transparent, not `--ox-plate`": still
  true in effect, restated rather than reversed. The plate now declares
  `background: var(--ox-bg)`, but `--ox-bg` and `--ox-surface` (the card's
  own fill) are both `#FFFFFF` in light mode, so this is a
  no-visible-difference declaration, not the grey box section 3.1 warned
  against. What actually changed is new content ON TOP of that ground: the
  PDP gallery's own grey band and orange mark
  (`ox-plate-band`/`ox-plate-mark`, `_primitives.scss`, shared by both
  surfaces so they cannot drift), at the same low opacity the gallery
  already proved keeps a white tub legible.
- **Excerpt line** (the coordinator's 2026-09-23 addendum, itself layered on
  top of this spec): removed again, this time for good — it repeated the
  title on the owner's own screenshot, and the facts line above it already
  carries the type. `descriptionExcerpt()` is retired from `cardSpec.ts`.
- **Section 5's sold-out equal-height reservation** (252/260): recomputed to
  204/210, measured live against the shorter body this addendum produces —
  see `docs/build/progress/S9a-V4.md` step 8 for the arithmetic.

Full implementation record, live measurements and screenshots:
`docs/build/progress/S9a-V4.md`.

**Instrument note.** `chrome-devtools-mcp` was used for every measurement above: viewport emulation at 390 and 1440, `evaluate_script` for bounding boxes, computed styles, live font text metrics, WCAG relative-luminance contrast and sallaicons codepoint resolution, and screenshots of the 390 card grid. The full §4 compositor probe from `mastermind-audit/references/mobile-render-budget.md` was not run end to end; the budget lines are a mix of Chromium measurement (scroller position, document width, `html`/`body` grounds, layout boxes) and source assertion (grep clean for `filter`, `backdrop-filter`, `will-change`, `translateZ` across `app/styles/06-ox/`). A clean probe here would be evidence the surface sits inside the numbers, not that the device is clean; G4 still measures the built output on the owner's phone. `ui-ux-pro-max` and `impeccable` were not invoked: the direction is already fixed by DIRECTION.md and X-IDENTITY, both of which are project-owned systems that outrank a generic detector, and the open questions tonight were arithmetic and claims law rather than style candidates.
